cause: Three hidden D17 fixtures enter the nearest24 normalized-distance candidates, pushing visible CommonsFixture_4 and CommonsFixture_3 from counterfactual ranks21/22 to zero-based ranks24/25.

The old +4 score penalty neither excludes occluded sources nor requires a tested clear sample. With only seven clear candidates in the tested window, nearest hidden NightGardenLocalSource_2 fills the eighth slot.
Both candidate-window starvation and hidden filler selection are observed; geometry corruption or a removed D17 fixture is not needed to explain the regression.

repair.eligibility: A requested, powered shadow source must return a positive _has_visible_sample result to become active. Hidden and untested sources remain disabled even when slots remain.
repair.ranking: Existing normalized distance and 0.08 visible-source hysteresis are unchanged; eligible sources retain that order.
repair.bounds: At most32 visibility candidates per refresh, with early termination once eight sources have qualified. Eight extra fallback candidates reach the directly observed displaced commons fixture; remaining slots are allowed to stay empty.
